notes.title: Free to Play Coming Soon
notes.content:
After long consideration, we've decided to make Under Pressure a free game

We held a vote in our UP Discord Server and found there was a majority interesting in expanding the game into the free to play market. We believe that this transition will bring in more players and hopefully more matches.

We're excited for the future of this game and we will continue to put in the effort to make this a game we all love.

Cheers,
Kawaiisun

notes.title: 0.6.1-1 Revelations Redesign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35109059/7ea8d9ee1dbcc08bb68c4061b2f1f449a4fd0889.png[/img][i]Preview of the official redesign for map two, Revelations[/i]

With update 0.6.1-1 we've successfully redesigned the infamous Revelations map

It's not exactly like it was but it still maintains the square map shape as well as the merkahbah and corner paths. We also gave the map more strategic positions and secret pathways in order to incentivize area control and team maneuvers. The new map features more of a metalic design versus the original abstract geometry design. Overall, the redesign has brought life and vibrancy to a map that was otherwise not very attractive to play on.

Furthermore, with this update we've added a TON of bug fixes
Some of these fixes include:
[list]
[*]Removed Phantom Players
[*]Gadgets can be Placed in Garden Caves
[*]Gadgets can be Shared Between Players
[*]Added a Player Retention Discord Popup
[*]Fixed a Couple Collider Bugs
[*]Fixed a Couple Spectate Bugs
[*]Fixed the Map Roll System
[/list]

The updates over the course of the next month will be issuing a bunch of new unlockables, badges, and quality of life additions so keep your eyes open!!!

Cheers,
Kawaiisun

notes.title: 0.6.0.0 - O A K T O W N
notes.content:
Hey all,

Just released update 0.6.0.0

In it we've added Map 3, OakTown

OakTown is a dark, close quarters map that takes place in a mystical forest home to a mysterious species. The map brings a new level of technical difficulty to the game by putting the flag posts in highly visible areas contrary to the map's overarching dead forest which makes it hard to spot opponents. The map forces teams to time their flag pushes strategically.

In addition to the new map, update 0.6.0.0 features a new Private Match mode as well as an even more balanced matchmaking system

The next couple updates will tweak the cosmetics of the current three maps, add more badges and equipment, fix any reported bugs, develop a solo/coop mode, and strive to make the game more visually responsive and impactful

We're excited to continue our work on this game until it plays, feels, and tastes like absolute butter

Cheers,
Kawaiisun

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER BALANCING
notes.content:
Hey all!

Released a quick update today that added in a balancing system so matches are more fair. No more getting teamed up on by a bunch of veteran players in your 4v4 matches lolol

We also added in lobby chat and tweaked the footstep volume so that it's a logarithmic dropoff and players don't sound like they're right next to you when their not even in the same game..

Cheers!

notes.title: Jukebox, Footsteps, & Pistol Sensitivity
notes.content:
Hey all!

In the latest update we've done couple things:


[u]Jukebox[/u]
The music for the main menu has been gutted and has now been replaced with a jukebox that plays selected music from the UP contributors community. Using the jukebox you now have more control over the song that's playing with normal song player controls like [i]skip[/i] and [i]play[/i].


[u]Footsteps[/u]
The footsteps of other players can now be heard from a much greater distance and now the volume of a player's footsteps is linked to their current action. While players are sprinting, their footsteps are the loudest - and while players are crouching their footsteps are the quietest.


[u]Pistol ADS[/u]
UP has a very unique game design that requires maximum agency over the controls. Since the only two weapons are a sniper rifle and a pistol the ADS sensitivity settings have been a bit difficult to find the balance for the two weapons. Now, the two weapons feature different sensitivity settings so the pistol's ADS speed will no longer have to be sacrificed for sniper accuracy.


That's it for this week's update! Next update will hopefully bring joining during the match functionality to the game!!

Until Then, Cheers!

notes.title: 0.5.0.0 is LIVE
notes.content:
Hey all,

Just released a major update which shifts the game over to a perpetual lobby system. You will now wait on the menu for a match to start so you can continue to customize your character and buy chests from the shop!

With the new perpetual lobby system, we've increased the potential for joining in the middle of matches (this will help the game immensely since there currently aren't very many people online). We will try and get joining in the middle of matches done by next week so stay tuned!!

Cheers!

Kawaiisun

notes.title: 0.5.0 MULTIPLAYER REWORK IN PROGRESS
notes.content:
Hey!

Just wanted to let you peeps know that I'm currently working hard on a HUGE update - I'm trying to rework the multiplayer so that there are way less bugs in our online matches and so that 4v4s are actually possible.


Some of the things I've added so far:
- perpetual lobbies (like mw2)
- new gear (including bodies, legs, and jetpacks)


And some of the things I'm still working on are:
- preventing cheats
- moving the save data over to steam cloud
- boosting the rare crates
- adding badges


Now, with this new update, save data will be lost but everyone who has owned the game before 0.5.0 will receive an exclusive early-supporter badge and anyone who has reached past level 20 before the update will receive another exclusive badge on top of the early-supporter.

You can check out this youtube video for a sneak peek at the new perpetual lobby system: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d8JlXKi-mrA&t=2s



Much Love and Happy Camping <3

Kawaiisun

notes.title: 0.4.9 Targets, Keybinding, Sensitivity, and Strings
notes.content:
Hey lads,

With this update we've finally added in keybinding. We also tweaked the sensitivity settings to be more precise and added a new mechanic for map awareness.

Along with the new keybinding options available in the controls settings and the more precise sensitivity sliders, we've added in a target practice mode so you can tweak your setup. It's also a good place to warm-up before you start a match.

You'll notice that your allies have visible lines above them. The same lines are drawn over your enemies when they shoot, but the line is only visible for five seconds. With this new mechanic, we hope navigating the map and trying to coordinate pushes with teammates is easier than before.

Other than that, we fixed a couple bugs and added in a score indicator to give your kills and objectives a little extra "oomph"

Cheers

notes.title: The Shop is Ready for Business
notes.content:
Hey lads,

Today we released update 0.4.8 which contains a fully functional store and equipment system. As of right now, only helmets are unlockable (and there's a small collection), but we'll be adding more throughout the week!

Additionally, we've fixed all the bugs we've received and tweaked the meta just a bit. 

The most important things we've added include:[list]
[*] Invert Look Option in Controls Menu
[*] Online Player Count on Main Menu
[*] A Self Destruct Button in Game
[*] A Scope Fade
[*] Louder Gunshots
[/list]

Lastly, we've removed the spawn protect during sudden death so players can no longer hide in their base in overtime and we've slightly decreased the pistol's firing rate.

With that all said, go start buying stuff in the shop

Cheers!

notes.title: Flags, Chat, and Scores!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Just finished build 0.4.7!

In this build we've added: [list]
[*] Flag Dropping (switch weapons)
[*] Flag Timer
[*] Color Coded Chat
[*] Join and Leave Messages
[*] Chat Available After Match
[*] A Better Scoreboard
[*] A Waiting Room List [/list]

We've also done a couple bug fixes with this update as well. We've made it so the flag no longer disappears randomly, matchmaking is less prone to errors, and the chat menu goes away by pressing enter.

Thank you for all your ideas and help - let's keep this going!!

Cheers!

notes.title: UI for Active Powerups
notes.content:
The score UI will now display active powerups and adjusts the score based on the powerup effect. This means that the score now more accurately represents pressure instead of just the total deaths of a team. If a team is Pressure Free and someone on that team dies, the UI will no longer increase by one.

Thank you for your support - if you find anything send us an email at kawaiisungames@gmail.com and we will start working on a solution ASAP!!

Cheers!
